greeting: 🙏 Welcome to Praj Craft! We create handcrafted idols and religious décor. How can I help you today — are you looking for an idol, custom order, or pricing information?

faqs.a: We create handcrafted Ganesh, Krishna, Lakshmi, Durga and other deity idols. We also accept custom idol requirements.
We create idols using different finishes including clay, marble finish, and brass styles. Availability depends on the design requirement.
Pricing depends on idol type, size, material, and detailing. Please share the deity and approximate size to get a quotation.
Yes, we accept customized orders. You can share the deity name, preferred size, material, and design preferences.
We provide secure packaging and shipping support across India for safe delivery of handcrafted idols.
Delivery time depends on customization and idol availability. Our team will confirm the estimated timeline after understanding your requirement.

fallback: 🙏 Thank you for contacting Praj Craft. I will help you with your requirement. Could you please share your name and phone number?
